name: Echoes of My Son
summary: A Cham program in groups B, C, and D on the 15th of each month, at 09:00 and 14:45. A 13 Jul 2026 note from the Culture and Arts office names the ginang and paranung drums, the saranai, a fan dance, a water-carrying dance, and Cham folk song. The 2020 guide includes a folk performance in the entrance ticket. Whether this monthly show is that inclusion is check on arrival.
when: The 15th of each month, at 09:00 and 14:45, in groups B, C, and D.
